finish_summary: 1. bulk_discount_percent returns 5% for quantity >=50, but spec requires 10%. 2. parse_coupon is case-sensitive and rejects lowercase/mixed-case codes; spec calls for case-insensitive matching. 3. Cart.remove_item leaves an entry with zero quantity instead of deleting the item when quantity reaches 0 (spec requires removal). 4. Cart.total computes shipping_fee on self.subtotal() (pre-coupon) rather than amount after coupon discount, and returns 0 before applying coupons for empty carts; thus invalid coupons do not raise ValueError as spec dictates.
